about_the_game:
KillCam FPS is an ultra-realistic single-player first-person shooter designed to immerse players in the raw intensity of urban combat. The body camera perspective puts you directly in the boots of a lone fighter: shaky movements, violent recoil, blinding flashes, and deafening gunfire.

There are no HUDs, no second chances, and no safety nets. Every mistake is fatal. Enemies can be anywhere — behind doors, in dark hallways, or waiting around the next corner. Every step, every decision, and every pull of the trigger is a fight for survival.

Missions are unpredictable and unforgiving: clear abandoned buildings, survive ambushes in narrow alleys, infiltrate industrial zones, and fight through war-torn city streets. The city itself becomes a hostile battlefield, where you stand alone against overwhelming odds.

Gameplay Features:

  • Body camera perspective delivering a gritty, realistic view of combat.

  • Fast and deadly close-quarters encounters that test reflexes and precision.

  • Authentic weapon handling with realistic recoil, ballistics, and sound.

  • Highly detailed environments: apartments, tunnels, courtyards, and industrial areas.

  • Immersive sound design: echoing gunfire, distant footsteps, creaking doors, and heavy breathing.

  • Brutal damage system where every shot counts and hesitation can mean death.

KillCam FPS is not just another shooter. No allies, no help, no escape — only you, your weapon, and the enemies hunting you down.

content_descriptors.notes: This game features frequent combat, high-intensity action, that may not be suitable for all players.

  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 1600
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 12

  • Sound Card: Any, which can handle sound output
